title: 修复半开区间的合并规则
issue:
Synthetic development fixture, hand-authored for PatchForge; not an external benchmark.

Repair merge_windows(windows). Each (start, end) is a half-open interval [start, end), with finite integer endpoints. Return sorted tuples representing the intervals after merging all strictly overlapping windows. Touching intervals such as (1,3) and (3,5) must remain separate because they share no included point. Ignore empty intervals where start==end. Raise ValueError for a reversed interval where start>end. Support negative endpoints, nesting and duplicates; never mutate input. The current implementation incorrectly merges adjacent windows.
